extracted.intended_audience: leaders and decision-makers at public relations agencies (prospective and current member firms)
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the value propositions, industry roles, and service standards the PR Council offers to member public relations agencies, including networking, data/research, professional development, and advocacy. Intended to guide agencies considering membership or evaluating association services.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support agency leaders to work smarter and create valuable firms
rubrics_metrics.description: Our mission is to support agency leaders in working smarter to create valued and valuable firms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: PR Council positions itself as an authoritative resource that helps grow member agencies and the overall industry by offering guidance, resources, and forums for leaders to improve firm value and operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Set industry standards and strengthen recognition for PR firms
rubrics_metrics.description: As an authoritative source in public relations, we set industry standards and strengthen recognition for PR firms.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Council claims a role in establishing norms and expectations for the profession; members rely on the Council to promulgate best practices and elevate the visibility and credibility of agencies.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collaboration & knowledge sharing
rubrics_metrics.description: We cultivate a dynamic exchange of ideas, insights and best practices to drive innovation and leadership in the PR industry.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasizes creating spaces and mechanisms (peer communities, forums, events) for agencies to share experiences and learn from one another to accelerate innovation and leadership development.

rubrics_metrics.name: Data & research (benchmarking and industry analysis)
rubrics_metrics.description: We collect and analyze industry data to offer valuable insights and strategic guidance, helping member agencies adapt, innovate and grow.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides tangible benchmarking products (e.g., Compensation Survey, Labor Billing Rates) that members use to support business decisions; positions research as a core service that informs agency strategy and operations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Professional development (workshops, webinars, conferences, training)
rubrics_metrics.description: We offer highly relevant workshops, webinars, conferences and training programs, empowering PR professionals with the skills and knowledge to excel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programs are targeted at agency staff and leaders to upskill teams; testimonial evidence highlights staff training programs as a concrete deliverable that helps agencies run more effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Advocacy & industry recognition
rubrics_metrics.description: We advocate for the PR industry, promoting its value and impact to stakeholders and collaborate with other associations to advance the profession.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes outward-facing advocacy and efforts to raise the profile of member firms; may involve partnerships with other associations and public campaigns to communicate PR's business value.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to networking, resources, and member-only events
rubrics_metrics.description: Get access to networking, resources and training opportunities when you become a member.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Members gain entry to events, communities (e.g., DEI, HR, Digital), and other member-only offerings; note that some events are visible only to logged-in members per the site.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deliver tangible, actionable benchmarks and tools for business decisions
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliverables like the Compensation Survey and Labor Billing Rates provide tangible benchmarks to support business decisions.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Testimonials highlight the rigor of Council reports as especially valuable; these research outputs are positioned as tools that enable agencies to make concrete operational and financial choices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide safe spaces for transparent leadership conversations
rubrics_metrics.description: For larger agencies, the Council provides safe spaces for leaders to engage in transparent conversations that allow us to look at the world of PR, client excellence and team building from different perspectives.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This criterion emphasizes confidentiality, candid peer exchange, and executive-level programming designed to surface strategic issues and diverse viewpoints for agency leadership.

rubrics_metrics.name: Be a practical resource for smaller agencies (expertise and guidance)
rubrics_metrics.description: For smaller agencies, the Council is a fount of expertise and guidance that support leaders.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Positions the Council as a scalable resource—smaller firms can leverage Council-produced content, templates, and guidance rather than creating them in-house, thereby gaining operational leverage.
